title: Minimum cost to cut a stick
statement: A stick of length n must be cut at every position in cuts (any order). Each cut costs the current length of the piece being cut. Return the minimum total cost.
hints: Intervals between cut points, not between all positions.
dp[i][j] = cost to make every cut strictly between cut points i and j; the FIRST cut k in (i, j) costs c[j] − c[i].

solution.explanation: Index the DP by cut points (sorted, with 0 and n added), not by positions up to n. That changes 10⁶ into 92. The first cut in a segment costs the segment's length and splits it into two independent subproblems. Here "first" works where in Burst balloons "last" did: choose whichever event makes the subproblems independent.
